data.narrative:
NODA AI is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Philong Duong and Dave Corbett, currently valued at $125M post-money on $29M raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 same-sector and adjacent-stage peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Singularity, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement to the current $125M post-money, yielding $250M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comp set identifies a $1.0B median valuation, with peer valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B. The peer sample skews toward Series B assets—Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B)—reflecting the sector's valuation profile.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $212M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $625M. The current $125M valuation sits below the low end of this range, suggesting meaningful upside potential at next funding. Key uncertainties include NODA AI's traction relative to the peer set, unit economics specificity, and customer concentration—factors not captured in stage or peer metrics alone.
